name: wake-engine
author: ForgeFront Systems
description: Wake Engine local command console V6

scripts.dev: npm run guard:local && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:installer: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.audit:wal: npm run guard:local && node scripts/wal-crash-audit.mjs && node scripts/wal-elite-audit.mjs
scripts.audit:phase9: npm run guard:local && node scripts/phase9-durability-security.mjs && node scripts/wal-crash-audit.mjs && node scripts/wal-elite-audit.mjs
scripts.verify:portable: npm run build && npm run audit:runtime && npm run audit:scheduler
scripts.audit:routes: npm run build && node scripts/route-contract-audit.mjs && node scripts/route-ui-audit.mjs
scripts.gate: npm run guard:local && node scripts/wake-gatekeeper.mjs phase-00-gatekeeper
